db module

Database module providing SQLite database operations for the School Management System.

This module handles all database interactions including table creation, CRUD operations for students, instructors, courses, and registrations, as well as database backup functionality.

db.add_course(course_id: str, course_name: str, instructor_id: str | None = None) → None[source]

Add a new course to the database.

Parameters:

  • course_id (str) – Unique identifier for the course.

  • course_name (str) – Name of the course.

  • instructor_id (str, optional) – ID of instructor assigned to the course, defaults to None.

Raises:

sqlite3.IntegrityError – If course_id already exists.

db.add_instructor(instructor_id: str, name: str, age: int, email: str) → None[source]

Add a new instructor to the database.

Parameters:

  • instructor_id (str) – Unique identifier for the instructor.

  • name (str) – Instructor’s full name.

  • age (int) – Instructor’s age in years.

  • email (str) – Instructor’s email address.

Raises:

sqlite3.IntegrityError – If instructor_id already exists.

db.add_student(student_id: str, name: str, age: int, email: str) → None[source]

Add a new student to the database.

Parameters:

  • student_id (str) – Unique identifier for the student.

  • name (str) – Student’s full name.

  • age (int) – Student’s age in years.

  • email (str) – Student’s email address.

Raises:

sqlite3.IntegrityError – If student_id already exists.

db.backup_database(backup_path: str) → None[source]

Create a backup of the database.

Parameters:

backup_path (str) – Path where the backup file should be saved.

Raises:

IOError – If backup file cannot be created.

db.create_tables() → None[source]

Create all necessary database tables if they don’t exist.

Creates four tables: students, instructors, courses, and registrations. Sets up proper foreign key relationships between tables.

db.delete_course(course_id: str) → None[source]

Delete a course and all its student registrations.

Parameters:

course_id (str) – Course ID to delete.

db.delete_instructor(instructor_id: str) → None[source]

Delete an instructor and unassign them from all courses.

Parameters:

instructor_id (str) – Instructor ID to delete.

db.delete_student(student_id: str) → None[source]

Delete a student and all their course registrations.

Parameters:

student_id (str) – Student ID to delete.
